title: Reducing Sedentary Behaviour
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind reducing sedentary behaviour and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply reducing sedentary behaviour in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using reducing sedentary behaviour to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to reducing sedentary behaviour. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
